rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the alcoholic drink and for referring to a variety of beer.

example.english: This beer is a little bitter.
example.jyutping: nei1 zek3 be1 zau2 jau5 siu2 siu2 fu2

rows.note: Use this classifier construction when referring to one serving, bottle, can, or other individual beer.

example.english: Please give me a can of beer.
example.jyutping: maa4 faan4 nei5 bei2 ngo5 jat1 gun3 be1 zau2
